# mdk_trace - target side instrumentation component.
#
# Drop this directory into a project and either add_subdirectory() it, or just
# list the sources yourself. The component has no external dependencies: no
# CMSIS, no HAL, no libc beyond <stdarg.h>/<stdint.h>/<stddef.h>.
#
# Config comes from mdk_trace_config.h when present (generated by the mdkdebug
# `trace_instrument` tool). Build it by hand with cmake of your own toolchain
# file, for example:
#
#   cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=arm-none-eabi.cmake
#
# Nothing here assumes a host OS; this file only describes the library.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

project(mdk_trace C)

# Every backend by default. Override from the parent project (or from the
# generated mdk_trace_config.h) if you only need one.
set(MDK_TRACE_BACKEND "itm" CACHE STRING "itm | rtt | uart | none")

add_library(mdk_trace STATIC
    mdk_trace.c
)

target_include_directories(mdk_trace PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
)

# Keep the component buildable with the same warning level as the rest of a
# typical firmware tree, without forcing it on the parent project.
target_compile_options(mdk_trace PRIVATE
    $<$<C_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang,ARMClang>:-Wall -Wextra -Wshadow>
)

# Recognised backends map onto the same macros mdk_trace_config_default.h uses.
if(MDK_TRACE_BACKEND STREQUAL "itm")
    target_compile_definitions(mdk_trace PRIVATE MDK_TRACE_BACKEND_ITM=1)
elseif(MDK_TRACE_BACKEND STREQUAL "rtt")
    target_compile_definitions(mdk_trace PRIVATE MDK_TRACE_BACKEND_RTT=1)
elseif(MDK_TRACE_BACKEND STREQUAL "uart")
    target_compile_definitions(mdk_trace PRIVATE MDK_TRACE_BACKEND_UART=1)
else()
    target_compile_definitions(mdk_trace PRIVATE MDK_TRACE_BACKEND_NONE=1)
endif()

# The RTT backend lives in its own translation unit. It compiles to nothing
# unless MDK_TRACE_BACKEND_RTT is set, so listing it unconditionally costs
# nothing and keeps the source list obvious to IDEs.
target_sources(mdk_trace PRIVATE mdk_trace_rtt.c)

# If a generated config exists next to this file, expose it on the include path
# so __has_include() finds it.
if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mdk_trace_config.h)
    message(STATUS "mdk_trace: using generated mdk_trace_config.h")
endif()
